content.purpose: Provide a DID-addressed water utility operations service (reservoir/main design + meter readings + leak/quality reporting) as an auditable, open-source reference implementation.

architectureDescriptionContext.mission: Provide tamper-evident, DID-native potable water primitives open to any AT Protocol client.
standards: WHO Drinking-Water Quality Guidelines (residual Cl, turbidity)

content.findings: Topology = directed reservoir → service-point edges sufficient for branched distribution. Severity DMN auto-routes public notices. Quality samples enable residual-chlorine/turbidity audit.
content.recommendations: Add EPANET integration for hydraulic simulation; add automated valve closure on critical leak; introduce DMA-level NRW reporting.
